## Summary

Describe the problem, intended behavior, and material changes.

## Validation

Explain what was tested and any missing evidence. Include Windows/display details for desktop behavior changes.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and avoids unnecessary infrastructure.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or the reason they are unnecessary is explained.
- [ ] Affected configuration, installation behavior, and documentation are updated.
- [ ] Compatibility or security implications are identified.
- [ ] No credentials, private signing material, or build outputs are included.
